title: Service Book
description: A log of every service and repair on the car (date, km from the odometer, type, notes, cost, workshop), and the car's details: model, VIN, total km, and RCA, CASCO, Rovinieta and ITP with days left. A Custom Code page shows MG Flasher's settings (map, Max Cooling, exhaust flap, valet) read from the DME, and sets them over the car's own diagnostic link: tapped twice, with the engine running (Valet only stopped in P), each confirmed by reading it back. Typed on the app's own touch keyboard, or imported from a USB stick.

de.bmw.infrastructure.VehicleInformation._optional: series and body type on the Car page; the selector for Custom Code

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle2._optional: setting Custom Code (needs the car's speed)

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.CDS._optional: setting Custom Code (needs the engine speed)

com.harman.infotainment.systemfunctions.._optional: Custom Code's live settings (the DME link)
